title: Heir of Fire
author: Sarah J. Maas
summary: Third in a young-adult fantasy series. Celaena, once the king's chosen assassin, is sent to a foreign land and must come to terms with her past and her powers, while the king's darkness spreads at home.
readIf: you like a long fantasy series where the heroine, the cast and the stakes all keep growing.
skipIf: you haven't read the earlier books, because the story depends on them and several viewpoints have separated.

pairings.reason: Another ensemble fantasy with sharp characters and high stakes, built around a tighter plot.
A comparable young adult fantasy with a fierce heroine and a brutal empire.
A more adult romantic fantasy with a similar mix of danger, training and attraction.
